articles.title: Taiwan alarmed as Xi’s stealth drone goes shipborne? GJ-21 pulls off catapult launch aboard warship
articles.description: China has achieved a major milestone in naval warfare, with its GJ-21 stealth combat drone completing its first electromagnetic catapult launch and arrested landing at sea. The tests took place aboard the Type 076 amphibious assault ship Sichuan during its late-October sea trials. The development marks a significant step in Beijing's efforts to integrate stealth unmanned aircraft into naval operations. Derived from the GJ-11 Sharp Sword, the GJ-21 is designed for reconnaissance, surveillance, precision strikes and suppressing enemy air defences. Could China's new naval drone change the military balance across the Taiwan Strait and challenge Taiwan's defences?

articles.title: No GPS, no permits: Tamil Nadu bars mineral transport vehicles without tracking devices from Nov 1
articles.description: No vehicles will be allowed to transport minerals without GPS devices installed by November 1. The devices must be integrated with the state's MiMAS portal for real-time location tracking. Currently, around 1.10 lakh vehicles are registered, but only 50,000 actively transport minerals. Lorry owners must purchase devices from approved vendors, with costs now around ₹4000. Failure to comply will result in legal action against lorry owners.
